label: StudyE9b-dense Study 2 (StudyE12 re-run): OFFLINE REPLAY OF COMMITTED RESULTS (StudyD14b 0.25-s traces). CPU only on flash; no GPU, no model server, no inference. Evaluation is the Nexar AP on continuous log P(Yes) scores; the per-episode utility is a TRAINING target for the admission ranking only and is never an evaluation metric. AP is comparable WITHIN this grid only.
lambda_note: lambda = positives per negative grid point on THIS grid (150 / 20467). StudyE12's 1-s-grid lambda was 150 / 5196 = 0.0288684, which is 3.9390x this value and is covered by the last sensitivity multiplier.
excluded_features: time since the standing query began
clip metadata (scene, light, weather) - primary predictor

c_shuffle_features_within_fold.description: each trigger's feature vector is replaced by one drawn uniformly from that fold's pool of trigger feature vectors (seed 0), which breaks the feature-label association while preserving the marginal feature distribution. Labels, cutoff procedure and budget are unchanged. P-trajectory must fall to P-random's level.

b_budget_1_equals_admit_all.description: At budget 1.0 every policy must equal admit-all exactly (AP at the first horizon, invocations, fraction of positives alarmed, false alarms per clip-hour).
